name: Tamsin Brandle

poster.hook: One gnome stoker, answers to Tam. Last seen climbing into a chimney. Again.

story.appearance: Small, wiry rock gnome with rolled sleeves, burn-pocked forearms and a leather tool apron whose pockets are named in chalk. Goggles pushed up into a lot of grey-brown hair that has never once been brushed.
story.concept: Tamsin is the chief stoker of the Thermae's Heart-furnace, the third in her family to hold the job. She knows every flue, damper and bellows in the works by sound. She also talks to the man in the fire, every day, because nobody else did when she started, and he is the best listener she has ever worked beside.
story.stake: If the Concord is renewed she keeps her post; if Torvak is released she loses her furnace and her friend. If the binding breaks badly she is closest to the fire when it happens.
story.goal: Make sure the vote is the one Torvak actually wants, whatever that turns out to be.
story.secret: For six years she has quietly propped Damper Seven open and fed Torvak spiced cinder-oil, so that he could breathe, think and talk. That's why the wards are fraying early. The Chancery would call it sabotage. She calls it kindness, and is no longer sure there is a difference.
story.voice: Fast, practical, over-friendly. Explains everything in terms of heat and draught. Calls fire 'he', and the furnace 'the old man'.
mannerisms: Cocks her head to listen to pipes as if they were gossiping
Taps anything metal twice before touching it
Eats while she works and offers you some, with sooty fingers
story.trinket: A wind-up bronze beetle that opens and closes Damper Seven's lock

ties.text: They share the furnace-room, a kettle and a running argument about the shrine schedule. Tamsin would take a knife for her and has never said so.
ties.public: Share the furnace-room, a kettle and an argument

ties.text: She lets the old tribune's granddaughter sit on the stoker's bench every Jubilee. She has been wanting to tell Vessia what Torvak says about her for six years.
ties.public: Lets Vessia sit on the stoker's bench each Jubilee

ties.text: She met him this afternoon at the outflow culvert, where he was trying to sniff the seawater. She hauled him out of the sluice and he hasn't stopped apologising.
ties.public: Hauled him out of the outflow sluice this afternoon

story.intro: "Tam. Stoker. I know where every pipe goes, and which ones to avoid. This way. Duck."

features.name: Gnomish Cunning
features.text: Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma saves.

features.name: Tinker
features.text: Spend 10 minutes casting Prestidigitation to build a Tiny clockwork gadget (toy, fire-starter or music box) that lasts 8 hours; you can keep up to three going.

features.name: Crafter
features.text: Proficiency with three artisan's tool sets; 20% discount on nonmagical gear; fast crafting of simple items.

features.name: Sneak Attack (2d6)
features.text: Once per turn, deal an extra 2d6 damage with a Finesse or Ranged weapon if you have Advantage or an ally is within 5 ft of the target and you don't have Disadvantage.

features.name: Expertise
features.text: Double proficiency in Stealth and Perception.

features.name: Thieves' Cant
features.text: A secret language of signs and slang, plus one other language of your choice.

features.name: Cunning Action
features.text: Bonus Action: Dash, Disengage or Hide.

features.name: Steady Aim
features.text: Bonus Action: gain Advantage on your next attack roll this turn if you did not move. Your Speed is 0 until the end of the turn.

features.name: Fast Hands
features.text: Cunning Action also lets you make a Sleight of Hand check, use Thieves' Tools to pick a lock or disarm a trap, or take the Utilize action.

features.name: Second-Story Work
features.text: Climb Speed equal to your Speed; use Dexterity for jump distance.

spellcasting.note: Species cantrips only. Spell save DC 12, spell attack +4.

equipment.name: Damper Seven key
equipment.note: A brass key on a leather thong

choices.label: Clockwork beetle
choices.value: A wind-up bronze beetle that opens and closes Damper Seven's lock

choices.label: Pipe-chalk
choices.value: A nub of chalk, worn to the width of her thumb, marked with the name of every flue she has swept

choices.label: Heel of bread
choices.value: The heel of a loaf, warm, wrapped in a Chancery maintenance order

flashback: What is the first thing you say to the man in the fire each morning?

ifUnclaimed.npc: Tamsin is absent, up a chimney: Pip, her apprentice, guides the party through the hypocaust in Act 2 and mutters about Damper Seven. Tamsin appears sooty at the furnace in Act 4, just as Torvak begins to speak, and says only: 'He's clear. Let him talk.'

reassign.beat: Knows the short routes through the hypocaust
reassign.text: You have walked the stokers' galleries a hundred times, or been dragged through the outflow sluice once. Either way you know the short route down to the Heart-furnace and which flues will scald you.

reassign.beat: Damper Seven propped open, and the spiced cinder-oil (letter: little-stoker)
reassign.text: You have known for years that someone props Damper Seven open and feeds the Surety spiced cinder-oil. You have never reported it, because the only effect you can see is that he sounds clearer.

reassign.beat: Talks to Torvak daily, so knows what he wants
reassign.text: You are the one person who has actually asked Torvak what he wants, and you have not told anyone the answer. He wants to be heard before anyone votes.

cuts: The Tamsin and Vessia furnace-bench Jubilee tradition.
